geography: 48 contiguous states and District of Columbia for household rules

povertyGuidelines.note: Alaska and Hawaii have higher guidelines and are not modeled.

snapRules.limitations: Simplified 48-state rule: no asset, immigration, work-rule, medical, child-support, homeless-shelter, utility-allowance, or broad-based categorical-eligibility adjustments.

schoolMealRules.limitations: Illustrative federal reimbursement value for one breakfast and lunch on 180 school days; actual school participation, severe-need status, community eligibility, attendance, USDA Foods, and meal take-up vary.

summerEbtRules.limitations: Requires a school-age child and receipt in a participating state, Tribe, or territory; eligibility may also arise through SNAP/TANF/FDPIR participation.

programs.name: Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program
programs.financing: Federal benefits and account outlays; states share administration costs.
programs.receiptAccess: Entitlement/rule-based, but modeled payment requires the household receipt switch.
programs.federalFiscalMeasure: FY2025 actual net outlays, full SNAP account
programs.agency: USDA Food and Nutrition Service / OMB
programs.householdMethod: Simplified FY2025 gross/net income tests, earned-income and standard deductions, dependent care, capped excess shelter deduction, and maximum allotment less 30% of net income.
limitations: Full account outlays include administration and related items beyond benefits generated by the household formula.
Eligibility is approximate and receipt/take-up is never inferred from income alone.

programs.name: Special Supplemental Nutrition Program for Women, Infants, and Children
programs.financing: Federal grant; no modeled state-financed savings.
programs.receiptAccess: Categorical and nutritional eligibility; user/preset must assert receipt and annual value.
programs.agency: USDA Food and Nutrition Service / OMB
programs.householdMethod: Explicit user-entered annual food-package value; no national benefit formula is imposed.
limitations: Income eligibility is generally up to 185% FPL, but categorical status and nutrition risk are also required.
Food package and retail value vary by participant category and state agency.

programs.name: National School Lunch and School Breakfast Programs
programs.financing: Modeled amount is federal NSLP/SBP obligations; state/local meal support is excluded.
programs.receiptAccess: Rule-based eligibility but actual meal participation is assumed only when receipt is selected.
programs.agency: USDA Food and Nutrition Service / OMB
programs.householdMethod: School-age children times 180 days times the 48-state free or reduced-price breakfast and lunch reimbursement rates, then the visible in-kind valuation factor.
limitations: This is a transparent reimbursement-value preset, not observed meal use.
Community Eligibility Provision, attendance, severe-need supplements, USDA Foods, and paid meals are omitted.

programs.name: Summer Electronic Benefits Transfer (SUN Bucks)
programs.financing: Federal benefit obligations; state administrative shares are excluded.
programs.receiptAccess: Rule-based in participating jurisdictions; modeled payment still requires receipt selection.
programs.agency: USDA Food and Nutrition Service / OMB
programs.householdMethod: $120 per school-age child when income is at or below 185% FPL and receipt is selected.
limitations: Some children qualify automatically through other programs; participating jurisdictions and application pathways vary.

programs.name: Temporary Assistance for Needy Families
programs.financing: Federal TANF account only; state maintenance-of-effort spending is not counted as federal savings.
programs.receiptAccess: State-designed and participation-limited; receipt and annual cash benefit must be entered.
programs.federalFiscalMeasure: FY2025 actual net outlays, federal TANF account
programs.agency: HHS Administration for Children and Families / OMB
programs.householdMethod: Explicit user-entered annual cash benefit; no national eligibility or benefit formula is imposed.
limitations: Cash benefits, time limits, work rules, sanctions, diversion payments, and take-up vary by state.
Federal account outlays are broader than cash benefits paid to the illustrated household.

programs.name: Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program
programs.financing: Federal block grant; supplemental state/local funds are excluded.
programs.receiptAccess: Rationed/state-administered; receipt and annual benefit must be entered.
programs.agency: HHS Administration for Children and Families / OMB
programs.householdMethod: Explicit user-entered annual energy benefit, multiplied by the visible in-kind valuation factor.
limitations: Benefit levels, priorities, fuel type, crisis assistance, and funding exhaustion vary by state and grantee.

programs.name: Tenant-Based Rental Assistance
programs.financing: Federal HUD tenant-based rental assistance account; local contributions are excluded.
programs.receiptAccess: Rationed; income eligibility never causes automatic modeled receipt.
programs.federalFiscalMeasure: FY2025 actual net outlays, tenant-based rental assistance account
programs.agency: Department of Housing and Urban Development / OMB
programs.householdMethod: Explicit user-entered annual subsidy, multiplied by the visible in-kind valuation factor.
limitations: Eligibility is not receipt; waitlists and local payment standards are central.
The fiscal account includes administration and special-purpose vouchers beyond the illustrated subsidy.
